caption: The drawing depicts a single round bowl shown from two perspectives: a top view and a side view. The bowl is reddish-brown in color and has a decorative rim with a repeating pattern of small notches or indentations. On the inner surface of the bowl, as seen from the top view, there are multiple yellow lines; some are wavy while others are straight, arranged in a vertical orientation. The side view below the top view shows the bowl to be shallow and concave, with the same notched pattern visible around the rim. Both views are rendered on a plain, off-white background, and there is a small, faint inscription centered below the bowl indicating further information.
title: Small Pie Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
